items.summary: Extend message styling support end-to-end to include the newly requested options: add Purple and Blue message colors, and add a Dodge message effect, ensuring group messages preserve and render these styles consistently (send, store, fetch, and display).

Define and implement how the app determines the user’s plan tier (Free/Pro/Ultra/Ultimate) using the existing premium membership data model where possible; if new backend state is required, add it to the Motoko UserProfile and expose a query for the frontend to read the current tier.

Update the group chat composer default style behavior so that, in group chats, the default selected message color starts as Blue (and remains Blue after sending/reset), while preserving any existing default behavior in direct messages.

Update the group chat composer (frontend GroupConversation) so the message input textbox is visually blue by default when chatting in groups (e.g., blue-tinted background/border/focus ring), without changing the direct-message chat textbox styling.

Add a group-chat composer “color changer” control that lets users choose/cycle message text colors with plan-based availability: Free/Normal = Normal only; Pro plan = Black, Orange, Blue, Purple; Ultra plan = adds Skulls effect and Flames effect; Ultimate plan = adds Dodge effect.

Implement locked-style handling in the group composer UI: styles not available to the current user’s plan must be visible but not selectable, and must show an English lock indicator (e.g., “Pro”, “Ultra”, “Ultimate”) and a toast/message explaining the required plan when clicked.
